about.title: Your Trusted Sourcing Partner in China
about.companyIntro: TaiSourcing was founded in Xi'an, China, in 2015 and has grown into a team of more than 200 professionals. Our sole focus is to simplify the sourcing process for businesses looking to import from China.
about.companyStats: Over the years, more than 5,000 small and medium-sized businesses have trusted us for all-in-one sourcing services, from supplier sourcing to door-to-door logistics. Today, 70% of our clients are engaged in e-commerce, and 70% of the products we source are exported to North America and Europe.
about.competitivePricesDesc: We always encourage our clients to compare our quotes with those they receive from other suppliers before selecting our service plans. Over 90% of them choose our Pro Plan because we consistently offer the most competitive prices.
about.qualityAssuranceDesc: We place a strong emphasis on product quality. We conduct thorough inspections of products before we ship them out. And we are the only sourcing company that provides 1-by-1 product inspections to minimize the defect rate to 0.
about.inHouseProductionDesc: Although we are a sourcing company, we have our own production department capable of handling tasks that many factories are unable or unwilling to do. These tasks include product repackaging, bundling, eCommerce preparation, dropshipping, and fulfillment services.
about.professionalTeamDesc: Our company has over 100 employees, each with years of experience in China sourcing across a wide range of products. In contrast, most other sourcing agents have smaller teams of fewer than 10 people with expertise limited to specific categories.
about.specialSupportDesc: For large-scale or rapidly expanding companies, we offer a range of tailored additional services. This includes assigning a team of up to 20 people, offering credit payment options, and more.
about.globalLogisticsDesc: We have established partnerships with major logistics providers worldwide, enabling us to offer competitive shipping rates and reliable delivery to over 200 countries and regions.
about.findUsSocialDesc: We are consistently active on social media, sharing knowledge about sourcing, international trading, e-commerce, and more.
about.readyStart: Ready to Start Your Sourcing Journey?
about.readyStartDesc: Join thousands of businesses that trust TaiSourcing for their China sourcing needs.
about.manufacturerIntro: Located in Baoji City, Shaanxi Province, known as 'China's Titanium Valley', our partner factory specializes in the production, manufacturing, and sales of non-standard products, titanium alloy materials, special products, and other items.
about.factoryShowcaseDesc: The factory is equipped with modern production equipment including CNC lathes, turning machines, punch presses, and more. It mainly covers non-metallic industries and processes such as casting, hot rolling, and precision forging. The factory focuses on the production and research of titanium screws and other fasteners for motorcycles, bicycles, and automobiles. With a comprehensive management system, the factory is committed to providing high-quality products to customers worldwide.
about.productIntroductionDesc: Our factory's equipment applications cover aerospace, aviation, industrial engineering, automotive engineering, power, and electrical equipment. We produce not only titanium alloy materials but also titanium products, titanium targets, and titanium bars. The factory also manufactures various standard types such as bolts, nuts, watch bands, and special products. Special products are usually custom-designed according to specific customer requirements. Additionally, our products cover everything from raw materials to finished products, enabling us to provide complete solutions.
about.forgingEquipmentDesc: Hydraulic press, mechanical stamping machine, fan
about.hotForgingEquipmentDesc: Heating furnace, vacuum heating furnace, forging hammer
about.productMaterialsDesc: CNC lathe, CNC milling machine, metal cutting machine, laser cutting machine
about.testingEquipmentDesc: Spectral analyzer, metallographic microscope, hardness tester, universal tester
about.equipmentFixedPartsDesc: Polishing machine, sandblasting machine, anodizing equipment

payment.title: Payment Methods Accepted by TaiSourcing
payment.description: The official payment methods that TaiSourcing accepts are listed in the following. If you have any questions about payments, or someone offers other payment information which is not listed here, please send an email to info@taisourcing.asia for further confirmation.
payment.paypalDesc: PayPal is one of the most convenient payment methods for small orders. However, PayPal charges higher fees (around 4.4% + $0.3 of the total amount) and the money will be frozen for 21 days for new accounts.
payment.alibabaDesc1: In order to provide more payment methods to meet different needs, our company has become Alibaba Gold Supplier to offer the Trade Assurance Payment service.
payment.alibabaDesc2: To finish the payment, you need to provide the Alibaba account email to your agent. Then your agent will help create a Trade Assurance Order on Alibaba, and guide you to finish the payment.
payment.alibabaDesc3: Please note that you need to pay 2% more of the amount, because it's the fee charged by Alibaba from our side. Each payment should be less than $5,000, or we need to split the amount into several payments.
